scope: Current scientific preferred inputs and every active inherited image. Findings do not themselves grant rights; frozen originals and scientific values remain unchanged.

scientific_inputs.finding: Int. Tables C 6.1.1.4, 4.2.6.8 and 4.2.4.3; Bondi/Rowland-Taylor radii and published atomic weights. No asset-specific redistribution grant located.

Original generator points to NIST FFAST for Z=1..92. NIST explicitly identifies FFAST as SRD 66 with reserved compilation copyright; the general non-SRD/public-domain statement cannot clear this data. FFAST.jl software Unlicense does not explicitly relicense this older SRD compilation.

Compiled Lobato parameters cite Lobato and Van Dyck (2014), DOI 10.1107/S205327331401643X. The file also retains unused Kirkland/Doyle-Turner tables. Author MULTEM source has GPLv3-or-later, but its current Lobato table is different; no substitution or numerical change is authorized.

CCP4 6.3/6.4 libccp4 has GPLv3/LGPLv3 texts; its syminfo.lib differs from this retained version beyond whitespace, including aliases/settings. Base attribution identified; exact derivative source/grant still needs confirmation.

Frozen archive has 14 members and four original source files, with exact-table.json and symm_table.f90 used by the generator. QualX source provenance is retained, but the underlying exact table compilation origin/grant is still unproved. Do not replace it with modern library output.
Existing separately frozen spglib v2.5.0 supplement with its original BSD-3-Clause notice; does not clear the older exact symmetry catalogue.
